messages:
Anna (Security Eng): Morning async — quick check. Did: ran KMS rotation dry-run in staging, kicked off Snyk scan, merged small perms PRs. Blockers: dry-run failed with missing iam:PassRole on the rotation helper. Today: fix IAM role + re-run, verify Snyk false positives, respond to compliance ticket.

Raj (Infra): Which role is missing? I can add the policy. Saw error: "User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rotation is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rotation-helper"

Anna (Security Eng): @Raj yep that one. I left the exact log in the run output. Also noticed alias collision for staging key alias/redwood-staging — looks like previous dry-run left a scheduled deletion. 

Morgan (SecOps): Heads up — Snyk flagged urllib3 high CVE-2023-xyz in the telemetry-agent (priority: medium). Link: https://snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-URL-001

SnykBot: New vulnerability detected: package urllib3@1.26.15 — high severity; introduced by telemetry-agent v0.9.2. Recommended upgrade to 1.26.16 or apply patch. See PR suggestion: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/488

Anna (Security Eng): @Morgan @Jules I ran a quick delta on call graphs — looks like telemetry agent only calls requests.get with certificate validation on. Likely low exploitability but we should still patch. I can open the backport PR for the release branch.

Jules (Compliance): For the compliance ticket INC-4231 I need the audit trail from the KMS dry-run (who scheduled deletion, when). Can someone paste the CloudTrail line or link the S3 object? We need it for the evidence pack.

Anna (Security Eng): Pasted CloudTrail extract in longform:
```
{ "eventTime": "2026-03-16T03:12:21Z", "eventName": "ScheduleKeyDeletion", "userIdentity": {"arn": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/ci-bot"}, "requestParameters": {"keyId": "alias/redwood-staging", "pendingWindowInDays": 7} }
```

Anna (Security Eng): That shows ci-bot scheduled it during a previous test. I will revoke that schedule and re-run dry-run after @Raj adds iam:PassRole for rotation-helper. 

Raj (Infra): Will add the iam:PassRole policy to role/rotation-runner in 20m. @Anna can you coordinate to re-run after that? I'll comment when done.

Anna (Security Eng): Yep. After re-run I'll upload the new cloudtrail lines to the compliance S3 folder and ping @Jules. Also will open backport PR for telemetry and bump the dependency in staging image.

Morgan (SecOps): Quick ask — anyone seen intermittent permission errors when CI spins up ephemeral staging VMs? I filed issue #612 on infra board. Not sure if related to key alias collision.

Anna (Security Eng): Not sure yet. If CI uses the scheduling role it could hit the alias state. I'll include a note in the re-run details. 

CI-Bot: Build #1024 for redwood/telemetry passed after patch branch applied. https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/1024

Anna (Security Eng): Action items: 1) @Raj add iam:PassRole to rotation-runner role (in 20m). 2) @Anna revoke scheduled deletion + re-run dry-run and upload CloudTrail evidence. 3) @Morgan open quick patch PR for telemetry if not already. 4) @Jules I'll ping you with evidence URL when done. 

Raj (Infra): On it. ETA 20m :thumbsup:

Morgan (SecOps): I'll draft the patch PR now and assign reviewers. 

Jules (Compliance): Thanks — I'll hold INC-4231 open until evidence is uploaded.

Anna (Security Eng): Will report back in this thread when dry-run succeeds or if I hit anything else. Thanks team :pray:
